title: 第5章 六扇门第6章 公门好修行
lines: “草民见过铜章大人。”
六扇门的门口，魏乐府见到来者之后，第一时间行礼问好。
“哈哈哈，还真是你啊，守成。”这名穿着官服的中年人见到魏乐府，也是赶忙前来说道：“手底下的人说你来找我，我还真有点不信。”
“走，里面谈。”
说着，对方就带着魏乐府进了六扇门。
这人名叫作田牧川，乃是六扇门铜章捕头，更是主管松阳县缉盗、匪患、江湖、帮派等等一系列事宜的人。
“这时候你来找我，是孟馆主有什么事吗？”田牧川随口问了一句。
“这一次，我是来投六扇门的。”魏乐府苦着一张脸说道：“还请铜章大人收留。”
这话说出口，让田牧川的脚步不由得一顿。
说实话，他还是很馋‘丁守成’这个四方武馆的老三，毕竟为人老实木讷是出了名的。
谁不喜欢自己手底下有这么一号干实事还忠诚的人物。
只是正因为忠诚，没人能挖得走对方。
他也挖过好几次，明里暗里的招揽都有，然而都被拒绝了。
可这一次对方来投奔，反倒没有让他开心，而是警惕了起来。
事出反常必有妖。
“守成啊，是怎么一回事？”田牧川看似随口问道，实则暗中观察着魏乐府的神态。
而魏乐府等的就是这话，他当然知道自己这行为反常。
但没关系，有孟惟给自己‘打配合’，完全不用担心。
“前些日子，我与那位铁线手的比武之事，铜章大人应当是知道吧。”魏乐府脸色越发的苦涩了起来。
“有所耳闻，听说你伤得不轻。”田牧川点点头，打量了一番：“只是现在看来，似乎是误传。”
“伤势不重，不过却给我留下了深刻印象。”魏乐府顺坡下驴，又说道：“也正因为这事，我就找师...孟惟。”
“想让他给我说个媳妇，好传宗接代。”
“铜章大人，这可有错？”
田牧川心里暗暗惊讶，居然连师父都不喊了，但再听到魏乐府这话，也是神色古怪的问道：“孟馆主没答应？”
讨媳妇很正常，特别是这年龄了还没有个媳妇反倒是已经算是晚了。
以前他还以为是‘丁守成’不愿意，没想到居然会是孟惟不让对方成亲。
田牧川也是老狐狸，一下子就明白了前因后果，无非就是怕有老婆孩子了，‘丁守成’不愿意再当老牛了。
“没。”魏乐府瓮声瓮气的说道：“我想孟惟也是有他的苦衷，不给我讨也可以。”
“那我也就要求说涨个一二两的月俸，以前的十两还是馆谷，我自己慢慢攒钱娶媳妇也行。”
“等等，你是说你交馆谷？？？”田牧川这次已经不是惊讶了，而是震惊：“你真是孟馆主的亲传弟子？”
所谓馆谷，就是学费和生活费了，只有外门弟子才要交钱的。
“这么多年了，我与铜章大人也见过了十数次了，是与不是铜章大人应该清楚。”
“若是觉得我说得假，大人请看。”魏乐府说着就把包袱打开一抖搂，里面除了衣物再无他物。
“你看我这包袱里就只有两身衣物。”
那二十两银子来时被他先藏好了，卖惨就得做得周全，而不是留了破绽。
这一刻，田牧川沉默了，然后又问道：“孟惟用什么理由拒绝了你涨月俸。”
content_en:
"The common people have met Lord Bronze Chapter."
At the door of the six doors, when Wei Yuefu saw the visitor, he saluted and said hello immediately.
"Hahaha, it's really you, Shoucheng." When this middle-aged man in official uniform saw Wei Yuefu, he also hurriedly came over and said, "I really don't believe my people said you came to see me."
"Let's talk inside."
With that said, the other party led Wei Yuefu through the six doors.
This man's name is Tian Muchuan, he is the head catcher of the Six Gates Bronze Badge, and he is also the person in charge of a series of matters such as anti-theft, banditry, rivers and lakes, gangs, etc. in Songyang County.
"You come to me now, Master Meng. What's the matter?" Tian Muchuan asked casually.
"This time, I'm here to vote for Six Doors." Wei Yuefu said with a bitter look on his face: "Please take him in, Mr. Tongzhang."
When these words came out, Tian Muchuan couldn't help but pause in his steps.
To be honest, he is still very envious of 'Ding Shoucheng', the third child of the Sifang Martial Arts School. After all, he is famous for being honest and dull.
Who wouldn't like to have such a practical and loyal person under his command?
Just because of loyalty, no one can poach the other party.
He had been poached several times, both overtly and covertly, but was rejected every time.
But this time the other party came to join him, but instead of making him happy, he became wary.
When something goes wrong, there must be a monster.
"Shou Cheng, what's going on?" Tian Muchuan seemed to ask casually, but in fact he was secretly observing Wei Yuefu's expression.
This was what Wei Yuefu was waiting for. Of course he knew that his behavior was abnormal.
But it doesn't matter. With Meng Wei to 'cooperate' with him, there is no need to worry at all.
"Master Tongzhang should know about the competition between me and the wire hand a few days ago." Wei Yuefu's face became increasingly bitter.
"I heard that you were seriously injured." Tian Muchuan nodded and took a look: "But now it seems that it was a misinformation."
"The injury was not serious, but it left a deep impression on me." Wei Yuefu got down the slope and said, "It is precisely because of this that I asked my teacher... Meng Wei."
"I want him to find me a wife so that we can continue the family line."
"Lord Tongzhang, is this wrong?"
Tian Muchuan was secretly surprised that he didn't even call him Master, but when he heard Wei Yuefu's words again, he asked with a strange expression: "Master Meng didn't agree?"
It's normal to ask for a wife, especially at this age, it's already too late if you don't have a wife yet.
In the past, he thought it was 'Ding Shoucheng' who was unwilling, but he didn't expect that it was Meng Wei who refused to let the other party get married.
Tian Muchuan is also an old fox, and he immediately understood the cause and effect. It was just that he was afraid of having a wife and children, and 'Ding Shoucheng' didn't want to be an old fox anymore.
"No." Wei Yuefu said angrily: "I think Meng Wei also has his own difficulties, so it's okay not to ask for it from me."
"Then I just ask for a monthly salary increase of one or two taels. The previous ten taels were still Guan Gu. I can slowly save the money to marry a wife."
"But..."
"Wait a minute, you mean you're Jiao Guan Gu???" Tian Muchuan was no longer surprised this time, but shocked: "Are you really the direct disciple of Master Meng?"
The so-called Tategu refers to tuition fees and living expenses. Only outer disciples have to pay.
"Over the years, Master Tongzhang and I have met more than ten times. Master Tongzhang should know whether it is true or not."
"If you think I'm lying, please take a look, sir." Wei Yuefu opened the bundle and hugged it. There was nothing inside except clothes.
"Look, I only have two pairs of clothes in this bag."
He had hidden the twenty taels of silver when he came. He had to do it carefully and not leave any loopholes in the misfortune.
At this moment, Tian Muchuan was silent, and then asked: "What reason did Meng Wei use to refuse your monthly salary increase?"
title_en: Chapter 5 Six Doors Chapter 6 Gongmen is good for practice
